final:
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  ex first_readable(["../secret"]) == ""
  ex first_readable(["/etc/passwd"]) == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for n in names
      if n.char_count() == 0
        continue
      if n.split("..").len() > 1
        continue
      if n.split("/").get(0) == ""
        continue
      if n.split("\\").len() > 1
        continue
      let t = fs.read(n) else continue
      return t
  ""
